Hair treatments have become a necessity for hair health thanks to the latest hair growth technologies. From receding hairline to significant hair loss treatment, these regrowth solutions can work for everyone regardless of their hair type and age. Because hair loss affects both men and women, many people consider opting for hair regrowth treatments. And for that, they often look for reliable and trusted hair treatment platforms.   

Today, there are a plethora of hair care facilities that specialize in hair restoration and offer various procedures and treatments. These hair care facilities vary widely based on experience, talent, and skills of their physicians. That is why it is important to choose a facility capable of offering high-quality treatment and care. You may also choose to go the other route, opting out of having to go to a facility for your treatment. Options such as laser caps and low level light therapy treatment can be done in your own home without visiting a clinic.

From evaluating the experience of physicians, studying the hair regrowth procedures to reading through the testimonials, you need to compare everything. Below we have included detailed features of two renowned hair loss treatment options to help you choose the one that suits your needs the best. Read below to learn more about HairClub vs Kiierr.

About HairClub

HairClub is a reliable chain of hair treatment centers in the United States and Canada. The renowned hair treatment facility aims to help people achieve the best possible looks hair-wise. Many people go to HairClub to receive an array of one-off salon treatments. They can also sign up for a range of recurring hair transplant sessions or even choose surgical practices to permanently alter the state of their hair.

Sy Sperling established HairClub for men in 1976 when he experienced severe hair loss and couldn’t find the right treatment for his receding hair. With HairClub, Sperling wanted to provide people (dealing with the same problem) with a better option.

Treatments in HairClub fall into three categories: replace, regrowth, or restore. The treatment center helps both men and women add length, thickness, and density to their existing hair. Depending on their treatment choice and budget, experts in HairClub can help people transform their look by using FDA-cleared tools and treatments.

The company also includes professional advice (one to one guidance) and customized solutions for hair needs. It offers multiple hair treatment options to help you deal with plenty of hair problems. Working in various locations across North America, HairClub offers solutions to reach your hair goals.

 The following are the solution options available at HairClub.

Hair Club Products & Procedures

In terms of hair loss products and procedures, HairClub offers several. They are as follows:

1.) Xtrands+

A complete hair replacement system that allows you to transform your appearance. Specialists will match the exact color, texture, and density of your hair and replace with new hair using a medical grade adhesive.

2.) Xtrands

A way to maximize your hair volume and density without a surgical procedure.

3.) EXT Extreme Hair Therapy

A mix between at home and in clinic treatments to help your thinning hair.

4.) Laser Technology for Hair Loss

You can choose from several different laser devices to use at home.

5.) FUT

Follicular Unit Transplantation. This is a surgical, out-patient procedure that uses your existing hair to replace on the scalp in thinning areas.

6.) FUE

Follicular Unit Extraction. This is a surgical, invasive hair restoration surgery that also uses your healthy hair to replace problematic areas.

7.) BioGraft

This surgical hair transplant uses a graft to replace thinning hair on the scalp

8.) Restorink

This is a non-surgical option that uses micro-pigmentation to restore the appearance of your hair.

9.) Hair Extensions

This option is mainly for women. The extensions are made with real human hair and are put in my professionals.

HairClub for Men and Women Health Solutions

Regrowth

The category includes non-surgical hair regrowth treatments to restore hair health naturally. It includes two hair treatment procedures.

  • Extreme Hair Therapy
  • Laser Hair Treatment

Replacement

It is for the people who have scalps with no or thin hair. Replacement techniques at HairClub are hair restoration options. The techniques include;

  • Xtrands
  • Restorlink
  • Extension

Restoration

 It is an option for surgical restoration for natural hair growth on thinning areas for a permanent solution. It includes techniques like,

  • Follicular unit extraction (FUE)
  • Follicular unit transplantation (FUT)

With a vast range of treatments, people often find HairClub expensive. The average cost of treatment begins at $300 per month. The surgical procedures, however, may cost you thousands of dollars for a few sessions.

Hair Club Cost

Unfortunately, there are no prices listed on HairClub’s website. If you are interested in any of the hair loss procedures and solutions they offer, you must submit a form with your information and they will get back to you.

Although there are no concrete prices listed, be prepared to pay a high price, especially for the hair restoration surgeries.

Kiierr

Kiierr is another renowned and reputed option when it comes to growing fuller and thicker hair. The pro hair treatment company is popular for its laser therapy to solve your hair loss issues within months. The company makes one of the best laser caps in the market. The advanced technology is a non-invasive restoration system that rejuvenates hair growth and makes it fuller, thicker, and stronger.  

Kiierr, with its laser therapy instruments, has introduced a scientific concept of low-level light therapy. 

The lights emit from the laser cap, stimulate hair growth, and reduce hair thinning. This process of photo-biotherapy happens when cells absorb laser lights and stimulate their protein synthesis and metabolism. The features that make Kiierr’s laser hair regrowth caps one of the safest solutions is its FDA-clearance, output power and laser diode wavelength.

Kiierr uses 272 diodes, which is more than many of its competitors, such as “HairClub for men” that uses 200 laser diodes. Remember that the more diodes a laser cap uses, the more powerful and effective it will be when helping to regrow the hair on the scalp. Typically, the laser light penetrates the scalp and improves cellular respiration. It stimulates the hair follicle and allows them to breathe for better functioning.

The laser cap is easy to use and optimally powerful. Kiierr uses only cutting-edge technology to give patients promising results. All they need is to wear a cap for thirty minutes every day. Interestingly, you can use Kiierr’s laser cap in conjunction with other hair growth treatments such as hair transplantation and platelet-rich plasma.

Read more: A Complete Guide to Kiierr’s Laser Cap

Hair Club Reviews vs Kiierr – Which One is Best for You?

Although both hair regrowth companies offer an array of benefits, you need to choose the one that fits your hair loss needs. There is no denying that HairClub redefines the haircare landscape by offering cutting-edge hair treatments such as Extreme Hair therapy and laser hair treatments.

But when it comes down to cost, commitment, and efficiency, Kiierr makes the better choice. Kiierr specializes in laser therapy and offers the safest hair regrowth treatment. Many scientific studies demonstrate how this technology makes your hair healthier and thicker. With its time-efficient home use caps, the procedure has become affordable for many. Kiierr even offers a payment plan that you can choose when purchasing your laser cap.  

Both products and procedures at HairClub are more expensive than Kiierr. Not only this, but HairClub requires you to visit the clinic for your treatments, where with the Kiierr laser cap, treatment can be completed in the comfort of your own home whenever is convenient for you.

Conclusion: HairClub vs Kiierr

All in all, both HairClub vs Kiierr both offer hair regrowth treatments for individuals suffering from hair loss. However, you must look for a complete package that helps you stave off bald spots or hair loss and is cost-effective and has long-term benefits.

Keep in mind that hair regrowth laser therapy at HairClub isn’t cheap. You may have to spend hundreds of dollars on maintaining the effects of treatment. Kiierr, on the other hand, offers services that are suitable, affordable, and effective for you.  

To learn more about hair growth options on the market, check out Revian Red Hair Growth System Review vs Kiierr
